question.text: Let a circle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mo>:</mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>h</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math>, touch the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>-axis at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>. If the line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> intersects the circle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Q</mi></math> such that the length of the chord <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mi>Q</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn></math>, then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>r</mi></math> is equal to _____.

solution.text:
Since the circle is touching x-axis so, k=r and h=1

Now by diagram, OP=r,PR=1

OR=r+12

r2=1+r+122

2r2=2+r2+1+2r

r2-2r-3=0

r-3r+1=0

r=3,-1

h+k+r=1+3+3

=7
